text: I feel a sense of curiosity and reflection. In the first scene, witnessing people engaged in discussion or learning behind glass walls, I feel like an outside observer to collective knowledge-making—reminded of the boundaries between self and community. In the second scene, the exhibition exudes vibrant innovation, celebrating research and development. I feel inspired and somewhat small amid the stream of ideas—awed by the ongoing quest for understanding, yet conscious of how each discovery shapes, and is shaped by, the broader network of minds.
